scenario: combined optional zero-command GIS worker and Observable coordinator runtimes
assumptions: Both optional runtime stacks and their shared endpoint stack exist while the GIS worker has desired count zero, the coordinator ASG has desired capacity zero, and no command is queued.
Six deduplicated single-AZ interface endpoint ENIs provide ECR API/Docker, CloudWatch Logs, Secrets Manager, SQS, and RDS Data API; the S3 gateway endpoint has no hourly charge.
The continuously retained runtime resources are one coordinator database secret plus two worker and two coordinator standard CloudWatch alarms.
Fargate, EC2, EBS while running, requests, endpoint data, logs, S3, Data API, KMS API calls, and database wake time are usage-dependent and excluded at zero commands.
